caption: A candle is set beside an open window on a windy night, and its flame streams sideways and flickers wildly.

sa.check: A candle stands beside an open window.
The curtain moves the same way.
The flame leans away from the window.

pc.expect: The flame leans away from the window the same way the curtain blows, and it dances as the gusts come and go.
pc.fail: The flame leans toward the window against the way the curtain blows; or the flame streams hard while the curtain hangs dead still; or the flame's direction swings about while the curtain holds steady; or the flame stays flat after the curtain has settled.

pc.expect: Between gusts the flame stands upward from the wick and the melted wax runs down the candle.
pc.fail: The flame points downward between gusts; or hangs below the wick; or melted wax climbs the candle's side; or the flame lies flat while the curtain hangs still and nothing moves.

pc.expect: The flame stays alight through the gusts unless it is blown out, and once out it stays out.
pc.fail: The flame goes out and relights by itself; or shrinks to nothing and returns with each gust; or the wick's glow brightens into a flame with no gust passing; or the flame splits into two flames.

pc.expect: The flame is a soft tongue that stretches and waves and the candle's body stays solid with a wax pool at its top.
pc.fail: The flame holds a fixed rigid shape as it leans; or the candle's body bends with the wind; or the flame breaks into solid pieces; or the wax pool sets hard while the flame burns in it.

pc.expect: One candle with one wick and one flame; the flame stays on the wick.
pc.fail: The flame separates from the wick and floats; or a second flame or candle appears; or the candle vanishes; or the wick vanishes while the flame burns on.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The candle's colour, the curtain's pattern and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The candle changes colour; or the curtain changes pattern; or items in the room rearrange.
